N001.summary: At the start of the game, focus on establishing a solid economy and teching up. Production is moderate, and the army composition is not yet defined. Continue developing your economy and technology while keeping production moderate. Avoid overcommitting to a specific army composition until you have more information.
N001.title: Early Game Tech Focus
N001.trigger_summary: At the start of the game, focus on establishing a solid economy and teching up. Production is moderate, and the army composition is not yet defined.

N002.summary: As the game progresses, you start to build a heavier defense and increase production. Your army is still undefined, but you are preparing for a ground-based composition. Continue to build up your economy and technology while increasing production. Start to invest in units that will form the core of your army, such as Marines and Siege Tanks.
N002.title: Mid-Game Transition
N002.trigger_summary: As the game progresses, you start to build a heavier defense and increase production. Your army is still undefined, but you are preparing for a ground-based composition.

N003.summary: You have reached the mid-game with a heavy economy and production. Your army is now ground-based with Siege Tanks, Marines, and Marauders. You are starting to expand. Continue to build your ground army and expand. Consider adding air support, such as Banshees, to harass or defend against air threats.
N003.title: Heavy Production and Ground Army

N004.summary: In the late-midgame, you have a heavy economy, production, and expansion. Your army is ground-based with Siege Tanks, Marines, Marauders, and Banshees. You are well-positioned for a strong push. Continue to build your army and consider adding Thors for additional anti-air and anti-armor. Push out to take map control or attack the opponent's bases.
